integrity: The claim follows from an exact decomposition of the global correlation integral and invariance of the separated components; no numerical or external certification is used.
limitations: Requires finitely many positively separated invariant supports, positive mixture weights, componentwise local pair-correlation laws, and convergent positive relative correlation-integral scales. It does not cover touching supports, countably infinite decompositions, convergence rates, or incompatible component scales.
title: Finite-component obstruction law for global pair-correlation normalization
